approach: Censored retail counts and Y sizes per elapsed step, affine calibration and a 512-step prior; rate/size lookup tables condition both spread and first-trade fair-price observation gain. The adaptive table did not clear the fresh paired gate; the delivered Strategy retains the promoted constant control. The complete tested adaptive source is preserved below.
